normalized_evaluator_dataset.name: 独立小型消息资源示例检索诊断集

dataset.provenance: Independent agent-created runnable synthetic corpus; requirements specify feature coverage. No implementation or previous cases read; not human annotation or production-project validation.
dataset.first_look: Source/rules and targets frozen before scoring. No retuning or relabeling after the first scored run. This set becomes development-visible after this run.
dataset.pre_scoring_schema_failure: First invocation rejected string version before indexing or scoring; metadata-only adaptation retained frozen source and targets.
dataset.metadata_adaptation: Prefix manifest/span paths, set evaluator schema version to integer 1, and move language metadata into this annotation file. Questions, labels, spans and source bytes are unchanged.
dataset.category_counts_meaning: Authored topic coverage, separate from the concepts actually recognized by the query parser.

freeze.provenance: Independent agent-created runnable synthetic corpus; requirements specify feature coverage. No implementation or previous cases read; not human annotation or production-project validation.

dataset_packaging.metadata_adaptation: Prefix manifest/span paths, set evaluator schema version to integer 1, and move language metadata into this annotation file. Questions, labels, spans and source bytes are unchanged.

v4.unicode_normalization: NFC+casefold; preserve letters,numbers,marks; split Han runs

anchor_rules.short_query: at most 3 distinct non-stopword concepts; every unknown literal is required
anchor_rules.explicit: backtick identifiers; underscore or mixed-case identifiers; uppercase acronyms; unknown titlecase words except the first run; non-Han letter runs in mixed-Han queries
anchor_rules.matching: NFC+casefold exact identifier or contiguous components within one identifier; Han literal substring; no cross-identifier assembly or inflection
anchor_rules.natural_language: other unknown words are soft ranking evidence; coverage denominator is known concepts plus anchors
anchor_rules.empty_gate: no known concept and no anchor means insufficient evidence
anchor_rules.stopword_precedence: explicit anchors are recognized before stopword filtering
anchor_rules.anchor_only_ranking: anchors may create candidates; if no concept matches, sum binary-frequency BM25 per matched anchor

behavior_policy.required: all recognized specific behavior concepts in one candidate and one execution scope
behavior_policy.evidence: non-stub function name, runtime Name.Load, loaded attribute, call target, call keyword, daemon attribute assigned literal True; visible complete source lines only
behavior_policy.excluded: comments, strings, imports, class names, parameters, annotations and type aliases, TYPE_CHECKING branches, placeholder functions including excluded-only or statically nonrunning bodies; daemon keyword requires literal True
behavior_policy.scope: module, class body, function, async function, lambda and each comprehension are separate; comprehension first iterable stays in enclosing scope, body/ifs/later iterables in comprehension scope; no cross-scope assembly
behavior_policy.selection: behavior queries gate the complete ranked pool before limiting hits; raw candidates retain top-k ranking; ordinary queries retain the v2 pre-gate limit
behavior_policy.conditions: preserve evaluated Boolean test prefixes even when the result is constant; omit only statically short-circuited operands and nonselected known If branches
behavior_policy.failure: unsupported language, invalid Python, node budget or analysis failure supplies no behavior evidence; ordinary retrieval remains available
behavior_policy.meaning: syntactic lexical evidence only; it does not establish runtime behavior or correctness

v4.line_boundaries: CRLF,CR,LF; oversized single lines omitted and counted

new_concept_coverage.basis: Concept recognized in v5 query.gate_concepts; cases can appear in multiple concept groups. Recognition and acceptance do not establish correct retrieval.

limits: All development targets passed, but first-look false abstention increased from 5/20 to 11/20 and false retrieval increased from 2/12 to 3/12. Recall fell from 0.45 to 0.40. This is a draft result, not evidence of improved generalization.
The first-look false-retrieval ceiling of 25% and recall-retention floor of 80% passed; these permissive thresholds do not mean either metric improved.
An independent AI agent authored a small runnable synthetic corpus with planned feature coverage. There are no independent human annotations or real production-project results.
Feature selection was guided by this iteration, multiple cases share functions, and category counts differ from actual recognized query concepts.
All five older sets are development data. The fresh set becomes development-visible after this scored run.
All answerable cases are included in recall/MRR, with abstained cases counted as zero. An accepted answerable case can still have zero relevant-span overlap.
AST identifier evidence is a lexical heuristic, not proof of runtime semantics. Aliases, natural paraphrases and cross-scope implementations may be rejected.
No generated answer quality, external provider benchmark, production accuracy or hallucination rate is measured.
